name: Run deterministic future-model proof through the live control plane
description: Verifies the critical live Morphosis workflow is functional while clearly distinguishing deterministic fixture proof from external-model verification.
steps: Open Evolution Lab and select future-model-x
Open Evaluation and Deployments, then return to Overview
expected: The run returns PROMOTE for the deterministic proof fixture, the model is labeled PROOF_PASSED rather than live ACTIVE, evidence and bundle records are visible, source authority remains HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, and the overview remains rendered with a smooth animated wavy speck field with rounded particles rather than square or block artifacts.

name: Register an unverified model and retain it after refresh
description: Verifies arbitrary registered endpoints never inherit trust from self-reported capabilities.
steps: Add model name qa-persistent-model, provider qa-provider, endpoint https://qa.invalid/v1, capability qa.capability.v1
Open Model Ecosystem, search for qa-persistent-model, refresh the page
expected: qa-persistent-model remains visible after refresh with UNVERIFIED status and no promotion or verified-evidence claim.

name: Reject an invalid model endpoint on mobile
description: Verifies malformed candidate endpoints are blocked without creating a record.
steps: Enter a unique model name, provider qa-provider, endpoint not-a-url, and capability qa.invalid
expected: A visible endpoint validation error is shown and the candidate is not added.

name: Persist observability controls and create requalification evidence
description: Verifies persisted control-plane settings feed the same qualification and evidence path.
steps: Open Observability and toggle Schema drift
Open Evaluation and Deployments, then return to Observability
expected: The trigger remains persisted, the requalification produces a new deterministic proof run with evidence and a rollback-backed bundle, and source authority remains human-gated.

name: Keep the product shell usable when the overview API fails
description: Verifies a backend projection failure is visible without collapsing the interface or visual layer.
steps: Observe the system strip and visual workspace
expected: A visible projection-unavailable message appears, the shell remains usable, and the visual layer is retained or gracefully falls back instead of rendering a blank broken page.
